description: List a filesystem's grants: id, principal_type (member, group or api_key), principal_id and mode (ro or rw). Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. Read-only and safe to retry. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.
name: list_grants
